mapper.sql: p.id, p.employee_id, e.employee_no, e.employee_name, p.external_employee_id, p.source_system, p.source_event_id, p.punch_time, p.punch_type, p.device_name, p.process_status, p.error_message, p.ignored_reason, p.import_batch_id, p.raw_payload, p.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM punch_raw_log p LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = p.employee_id AND e.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE ORDER BY p.punch_time DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM punch_raw_log p LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = p.employee_id AND e.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE
SELECT p.process_status AS processStatus, COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM punch_raw_log p LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = p.employee_id AND e.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE GROUP BY p.process_status
SELECT FROM punch_raw_log p LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = p.employee_id AND e.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE punch_raw_log SET employee_id = #{employeeId}, process_status = #{processStatus}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_name, status FROM punch_import_batch WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE punch_import_batch SET total_count = #{totalCount}, success_count = #{successCount}, duplicate_count = #{duplicateCount}, unmatched_count = #{unmatchedCount}, error_count = #{errorCount}, ignored_count = #{ignoredCount}, status = #{status}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
